features[grid].title: Closed-Loop Servo Motor Extruder
features[grid].description: Tap. Switch. Done. Unlike traditional motor-driven systems, X2D packs a Gear-and-Trigger mechanism into the toolhead. The nozzle-change lever taps the trigger arm, driving an internal gear train to change the nozzle. No extra weight. Just a clean swap.

features[grid].description: A lighter toolhead means less inertia and vibration. Even at full speed, surfaces stay flawless - all the way to the top.
